name: SUTD DSL Starter Kit (Cmod A7-35T)
master_xdc_source: SUTD 30.110 Digital Systems Lab kit pin map, derived from Digilent's Cmod-A7-Master.xdc

clock.note: 12 MHz oscillator on the Cmod A7.

button.note: Cmod A7 on-board BTN0-BTN1, read 1 when pressed. Debounce.

key.note: Kit push keys. Polarity not confirmed: check with a test design before relying on it. Debounce.

seg.note: Common-cathode display: segments active-high, seg[0]=A ... seg[6]=G.

digit.note: 6 digit selects (hex[0] = rightmost), 0 enables. Multiplex at about 1 kHz per digit.

rgb.note: Cmod A7 RGB LED, 0 lights a colour.

adc.note: MCP3202 12-bit SPI ADC on Pmod JA.

uart_tx.note: FPGA transmit -> USB-UART bridge -> PC. Idle high.

uart_rx.note: PC -> USB-UART bridge -> FPGA receive. Asynchronous: synchronise.

gpio.note: DIP header pins not used by the kit.

notes: Polarities come from the SUTD course materials. Key polarity is unconfirmed.
The kit uses most of the Cmod A7 DIP pins; only the pio* ports listed in master.xdc are free.
